<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1158
Claimant:
Olivia Butler
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
11/24/2023
Claim opened after a rear-end collision reported by the insured driver. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all
further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
12/04/2023
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact. The other
driver's statement describes the collision the same way the claimant does.
12/07/2023
Photos from the scene and the other driver's account are consistent with the rear-end impact as described. Daamge
to the claimant's vehicle lines up with the reported force of the collision.
12/09/2023
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the policy start.
12/21/2023
Claimant reports a knee injury from the impact. The reported injury fits the kind and force of the crash, and no earlier
injury to the same area is known from prior records.
12/24/2023
Vehicle inspection found no earlier damage to the claimant's vehicle. The repair estimate covers only damage tied to
this impact.
01/23/2024
Claimant's attorney submitted the medical file. Treatment followed a usual course for this type of injury and tapered
off as the patient improved.
04/01/2024
In a follow-up interview, the claimant added a few small details about the sequence of events. The core account of
the collision has stayed the same since the first report.
04/10/2024
Reviewed the witness statements, scene photos and the other driver's account together. All sources agree the
accident happened as described.
06/08/2024
Medcial and repair documents are complete and consistent with the reported loss. File is moving toward settlement
review with the attorney's office.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
